name: AudienceRatingsAnalyzer
tagline: Ratings, share, targets and audience guarantees – one drop-in Power Apps app for broadcast research and ad sales.
description: A complete broadcast ratings module: post overnight to final ratings per telecast, compare programmes and dayparts with targets, and track every advertiser deal's audience guarantee with pacing, ADU liability and makegood suggestions. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen or model-driven form and connects to any collection, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel or SQL table through column dropdowns.
features: Rating index vs target with configurable threshold
Deal guarantee pacing and ADU owed with value
Makegood unit suggestion and Schedule ADU event
Ratings-status workflow with rules and undo
Bulk advance, dispute, exclude, delete, export CSV
Configurable dayparts, status labels, colours, currency
Phone layout with bottom view bar
